title: Nosana Skill Ecosystem Schema Registry
description: Central index of all typed JSON contracts in the Nosana skill ecosystem. Use this to discover contract IDs, their producers, consumers, and file paths.

schemas.title: Orchestration Request
schemas.description: Typed high-level deployment intent with 7 intents, topology, budget cap, and approval flag

schemas.title: Orchestration Plan
schemas.description: Deterministic execution plan with typed steps, dependency graph, cost summary, and failure predictions

schemas.title: Orchestration Result
schemas.description: Final typed output with step results, service URLs, job addresses, and terminal state

schemas.title: Deployment Plan
schemas.description: Complete deployment specification: job definition, market, strategy, healthcheck, failure predictions

schemas.title: Workload Classification
schemas.description: Classified workload type, VRAM estimate, framework, and GPU requirement

schemas.title: Market Routing
schemas.description: Selected market with routing rationale, fallbacks, and availability score

schemas.title: Template Selection
schemas.description: Chosen job template with parameter overrides

schemas.title: Healthcheck Configuration
schemas.description: HTTP healthcheck spec: endpoint, interval, timeout, expected status

schemas.title: Failure Prediction
schemas.description: Pre-deployment risk predictions with confidence scores and preventive actions

schemas.title: Execution Input
schemas.description: Operator invocation payload derived from deployment-plan

schemas.title: Execution State
schemas.description: Real-time polling snapshot of job state during execution

schemas.title: Execution Receipt
schemas.description: Terminal execution outcome with job address, service URLs, final state, and timing

schemas.title: Failure Report
schemas.description: Classified failure for routing. Maps to incident-input via field-mapping.yaml

schemas.title: Incident Input
schemas.description: Unified incident intake. Accepts failure-report embed or direct deployment-manager events

schemas.title: Failure Classification
schemas.description: Root-cause classification output from taxonomy lookup

schemas.title: Remediation Plan
schemas.description: Ordered recovery actions with operator routing. Consumed via field-mapping.yaml reverse_mapping

schemas.title: Recovery Result
schemas.description: Terminal recovery outcome: recovered / degraded / fatal / escalated

schemas.title: Deployment Request
schemas.description: Lifecycle operation request: create, update-revision, scale, stop, start, fund-vault

schemas.title: Deployment Status
schemas.description: Lifecycle state snapshot: DRAFT/STARTING/RUNNING/STOPPING/STOPPED/INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS/ERROR/ARCHIVED

schemas.title: Vault Status
schemas.description: NOS balance health: SUFFICIENT/MARGINAL/CRITICAL/DEPLETED with shortfall amount

schemas.title: Market Data
schemas.description: Live market snapshot: price/sec, queue depth, node count, availability score per market slug

schemas.title: Wallet Status
schemas.description: Wallet SOL/NOS balances and deployment readiness flag

schemas.title: Cost Estimate
schemas.description: Per-job, hourly, daily, monthly NOS costs with queue contention warning
